audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a sharp, high-pitched electronic alarm sound. A female voice gasps and expresses pain. Instantly, an upbeat, mid-tempo BGM with a quirky synthesizer melody and a steady 4/4 drum beat kicks in, setting a humorous vlog tone. (2) A 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition into clear Mandarin narration. The female speaker has an articulate, animated, and friendly professional tone. The BGM remains as a persistent bed at a lower volume, providing a rhythmic pulse without any background environmental interference. (3) Frequent sound design artifacts such as 'pops' and 'dings' occur alongside the appearance of text and graphics on the visual track. Each new health tip or symptom mentioned is punctuated by a rhythmic accent in the edit, reflecting a highly technical post-production style. (4) During a demonstration of pain, the narrator's voice mimics the sound of a cough and strained breathing. An 'impact' SFX is heard during a graphic illustration of a massage. The vocal is high in dominance and energy, maintaining a consistent pace until the music cleanly fades out at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Personal Anecdote -> Medical Diagnosis Process -> Symptom List -> Causal Theory -> Recovery Advice -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator uses a personal health scare to educate her audience about Costochondritis. She describes the terrifying initial sensation of chest pain, her subsequent medical journey from cardiology to orthopedics, and provides viewers with practical advice on symptoms, causes, and treatment to prevent unnecessary panic.
